# outputs/iod/analysis/ — Comprehensive figures

## Purpose

Summary dashboards and per-event diagnostic plots for the driver–MHW relationship.

## Typical contents

CSV tables (often under `csv/` or at folder root) and PNG/PDF figures (often under `figures/`). Per-region files named with `north` / `central` / `south`; many stages include a `summary.csv`.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/iod_analysis.py (analysis figures / orchestration)`

## Upstream / Downstream

Reads MHW catalogues + IOD index timeseries; feeds `outputs/climate_comparison/` and `outputs/master_event_catalogue/`.

## Notes

Part of the comparable six-stage design shared by ENSO, IOD, and MEI. See parent `outputs/iod/README.md`.
